scoreBefore.style: A moody, atmospheric dream-pop trip-hop track built on a foundation of a deep sub-bass and a crisp, lo-fi drum machine beat with a prominent snap. A breathy, sultry and ethereal female vocal, saturated in reverb, whispers and sings softly over hazy, melancholic synth pads The verses start off in a grounded, lower register. The arrangement is spacious and nocturnal, with layered vocal harmonies adding depth to the chorus which moves from a sulty and nostalgic atmosphere to an intense and soaring chorus. The track concludes with a section of wordless, humming vocalizations that fade out alongside the atmospheric textures, leaving a lingering sense of introspection and satisfaction., 90 bpm, F minor, 4/4 time
